column1: # wikify symbol index: torchtitan @ 2ad96c9390, shard torchtitan/overrides, 142 rows. Grep it by anchor; never read it whole.

# one module:  awk -F'\t' '$2=="torchtitan/overrides/fused_mla.py"' catalog/symbols/*.tsv | cut -f1,3,4 | head -40
